description.zh:
预热区域。取值：
- domestic：中国内地。
- overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
- global：全球加速。
 
如果不传该参数，默认的预热区域为您的域名所配置的加速区域。
description.en:
The prefetch area. Valid values:
- domestic: the Chinese mainland.
- overseas: outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China).
- global: global acceleration.
 
If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch area is the acceleration region configured for your domain name.

description.zh: 直播URL，支持批量设置多个直播URL，多个URL之间用逗号（,）分隔，不超过100个。
description.en: The live stream URLs. You can specify multiple URLs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 URLs can be specified.

description.zh: 预热结束时间，UTC格式，例如：2016-06-30T19:00:00Z，EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过6小时。
description.en: The end time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 6 hours.

description.zh: 预热开始时间，UTC格式，例如：2016-06-29T19:00:00Z，不填默认预热1小时。
description.en: The start time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z. If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch duration is 1 hour.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口可支持批量设置直播流预热，最多可一次性设置100个直播URL。
- 直播预热仅不支持HLS格式的地址。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to set live stream prefetch tasks in batches. You can set up to 100 live stream URLs at a time.
- Live stream prefetch does not support HLS URLs.
## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-live-stream-preload-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --play-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --area domestic --preloaded-start-time 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z --preloaded-end-time 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
